## Design

### 2026-10-18 – GrabbiExtendo - Link done!

**5h**

GrabbiExtendo - Link done!

Used Fusion 360 and made a 88 mm bar with three 3.5mm pin holes(Small isn't it?) It turns out the hedge shears I have in my backyard which I showed in the video are way too heavy for the jaw and the overall structure to carry, so I decided to adapt my mechanism for regular pruning shears! Which are much smaller but still effective.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8gj7S6WIDaEIJSjTsLHoa4RS9wzwJHca/46f9017a1425c867a8a091eaef6cdc382eae9765c924ad586c6e1af66665709f.png)
Here is the frontal view, as you can see each bar forms an "X", and since there's 4 bars there's 2 "X" which are also connected. Now, to make two bars an "X" I used a revolute type joint in the hole of the middle, and then I duplicated it to make the second "X".
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8gj7S6WIDaEIJSjTsLHoa4RS9wzwJHca/edae5cbce629f3a3e453d76f8203d95d31db22ac770adb3a00f82d727f9a8aa9.png)
What really took me more time was trying to join these two, I dragged my cursor over an "X" and tried to drag it to fuse but it would just go over the second, or just stay behind it
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8gj7S6WIDaEIJSjTsLHoa4RS9wzwJHca/9095521d0b43809a552be4fa1aee99af17c78f79a7fa6b8c64e506eb5cc4c06b.png)
Point to point move type helped a lot! After that I only had to move to move it very little with free move and done.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8gj7S6WIDaEIJSjTsLHoa4RS9wzwJHca/009f43848247eb517e1d11bc32828aa9925788ec3b633db8ac90c9b0f8399990.png)
Also faced some problems when making the three circles, I was modifying the size of the circles but got a "over-constrained sketch" error, it turns out I had applied an "Equal" constraint to all three circles and modifying one that already had a set constraint was the issue, I had to delete them all and set the new final value first, then apply the constraints.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/8gj7S6WIDaEIJSjTsLHoa4RS9wzwJHca/76f29186b53d948f7f9fa32d091da65969fc4e2dd283f0bde18f5e1e8b935839.png)
Also added the pins while writing this journal, I used an offset plane from the circles with 1mm of distance so I could replicate the head of a bolt(Which I also made if you see the pic). I'll add the rest of the pins once the whole thing is finished. I'll make the handle next.
